name: mooter-workspace-agent-anchor
description: Workspace anchor for the Live Preview anchored-task agent (LP-4.5 / W2). Declares the headless @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk that live-edit-task-runner.mjs import()s FROM THE WORKSPACE at edit time. Dev-only: the shipped mooter router + landing product never import it, and it is NEVER bundled in the vscode-extension vsix (a separate package; live-edit-packaging.test.js pins that the extension deps must not carry it). Workspace Trust is required before the agent runs.
